user.title: Start Coway Local
user.description: This integration hosts the fan’s local services. Use a reserved LAN IPv4 address reachable by the fan. After setup, choose Configure → Add fan. Tested with AP-1022K only.

error.invalid_server: Enter a reachable IPv4 address, three different ports (1024–65535), and an HTTPS provisioning URL.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Coway Local server is needed. Use Configure to add another fan.

pairing.title: Bluetooth setup
pairing.description:
Bluetooth setup opens in a new tab. Use Chrome on a nearby Mac or Android device, keep the Coway app closed, and leave this dialog open. If the tab does not open, use the button below.

When setup finishes, you will return here automatically. Home Assistant will verify the fan’s connection and confirm its 3-week pre-filter cleaning interval. No Submit step is needed. The setup link expires in 15 minutes.

server.title: Server settings
server.description: Changing the advertised address or ports requires provisioning existing fans again. Reserve the host’s LAN address before setup. Changing settings restarts this integration.

error.invalid_server: Enter a reachable IPv4 address, three different ports (1024–65535), and an HTTPS provisioning URL.

abort.pairing_expired: Setup expired. Choose Add fan to create a new link.
abort.cannot_start_pairing: Could not start setup. Check that the local service is running, Home Assistant has a frontend URL, and there are fewer than eight active setup attempts.
abort.pairing_interrupted: Setup was canceled or the local service stopped. Choose Add fan to start again.
abort.fan_ready:
**Fan ready**

Your fan is connected and ready to control in Home Assistant. You can close this dialog.

progress.verify_connection:
Your Wi-Fi settings have been sent. Home Assistant is waiting for the fan to connect and confirm its initial settings.

This can take another **1–2 minutes**. Keep the fan powered on and leave this dialog open. Setup will finish automatically.
